verdict.rationale: Skyvern is an AI browser-automation agent platform, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for it. The evidence only documents Skyvern running as an MCP server that other assistants (Claude, Cursor, etc.) connect to. That is the opposite role and does not show Skyvern can consume external MCP servers' tools. Nothing in the pack shows Skyvern plugging in third-party MCP servers.
